description: Example of a Cover chapter. Cover is now a standard chapter stored in chapters/ directory, NOT a standalone cover.json file. The chapter_title should be 'Обложка' and type should be 'cover'. The chapter contains a single scene with one typography unit for the book title and author.
notes: Cover is a regular chapter (chapters[0]) with chapter_title 'Обложка' and type 'cover'
It MUST have a standard 'chapter' (ch-XXXXXXXX) and 'chapter_title' ('Обложка') fields
Inside it has a 'scenes' array with one scene containing 'type': 'cover'
The scene has 1 typography unit with visual.text_render: true
The system processes the Cover chapter like any other chapter — it gets a chunk, audio placeholder, etc.

visual.prompt: full frame book cover design, vertical composition, classic russian literature aesthetic, elegant serif typography, top small text: author name, center large text: book title, dark background with golden accents, cinematic mood
visual.quality: highly detailed, sharp typography, clean composition
